facts.business: Emmforce Autotech Limited manufactures niche automotive drivetrain parts such as differential housings, lockers, covers, 4WD locking hubs, spindles, axles, shafts, gear shifters, yokes, spools, tools, and various forged/cast differential parts primarily for 4-wheel drive and performance racing vehicles, offering integrated engineering solutions from conceptualization to manufacturing.
